title: Three verification scopes — be the stranger
grounds: every claim is one of: [verified: offline, this machine] / [requires: network] / [maintainer-reported]. Checks that require network, run them anonymously: npm registry for the shipped version; the public repo is wiber/thetacog-mcp (the monorepo is private, and a maintainer saying public-to-me is not public)
shallow_error_without: the Part 5e class, in either direction: crediting maintainer-reported figures as verified, or scoring a private remote as deception
